release_notes:
- "Save to project folder" is now next to every download that belongs to a project: PRISMA, risk of bias, data extraction, meta-analysis, GRADE, PICO, screening, Library, Reader, search strings, writing tools, qualitative tools, trial tools and the AI tools. Files go to a "Nexus SR exports" folder inside your project folder, sorted by section, and Nexus SR never imports them back as a new library or as PDFs to attach. The button appears once you have chosen a project folder in Projects.
- AI Screening: results saved from an earlier batch now show up even when the library has no groups yet, and the library list in "Load studies" is no longer cut off.
- With Nexus AI you can now cancel a running AI batch, and the ops are given back.
- Chat with PDF: long conversations no longer get more expensive with every question.
- Starting Nexus SR no longer closes another program that uses the same port, and on Mac reopening it with Safari open no longer closes Safari.
- Windows: restoring a backup from the backup manager works again.
- Search String Creator warns you about terms repeated in two blocks and about MeSH headings written back to front, such as "Neoplasms, Breast".
- Help now explains the full-text AI batch and the mobile Inbox, and read-only mode tells you why an action did nothing in a few places where it stayed silent.
- Smaller fixes in Citations, the Reader annotations and risk of bias, which now uses less of your computer when you are on another tab.
